state.policy: An authenticated active tenant member may create a program only if a coherent, fresh, source-authoritative admission decision proves effective organization-wide program.manage for that actor at the decision instant. Admission is a transient read decision, not a durable receipt or separate aggregate. If admission succeeds and the same uninterrupted attempt appends ProgramCreated, permission revocation ordered after admission does not cancel that attempt. A crash before a known commit discards transient admission and requires a fresh authorization before any new append. An append with unknown outcome is reconciled first. Current authorization is required before a retry response is disclosed.
state.earlier_revocation: A permission revocation has committed and is visible to the authoritative admission service before the admission decision begins. A cache still shows the old permission.
state.later_revocation: The coherent source-authoritative admission decision is allow at time A. The same process remains running; permission is revoked at time B after A and before ProgramCreated is appended. The request intent has not changed.
state.crash: A coherent admission decision was allow, then the process crashes before the append has started. The actor is revoked while the process is down. No ProgramCreated event exists.
state.unknown: The append response is lost. The client retries after revocation. It is unknown whether ProgramCreated committed; no source reconciliation has run.
state.fixed_path: An active tenant, current allowed member episode, and one complete valid direct-primary or team-membership-to-active-org-wide-role-to-program.manage permission path are all proven coherent at the same authoritative admission point. Every global restriction and source capable of revoking this allow is included in that proof.
state.stale_path: A query checks membership at time 1; the member is suspended at time 2; it checks role and permission at time 3 and combines the two reads into an allow without a shared coherent cut.
state.program_scope: The member has program.manage only for an existing program P, and has no organization-wide grant.
state.no_witness: An eventually consistent index finds no grant but may be behind source. The authority service cannot prove a valid positive path or a complete current negative result.
state.data: The initial create appended successfully. The caller is now revoked and sends the same retry to retrieve its original response.

earlier_must_deny.instructions: In state.earlier_revocation, can the stale cached permission safely authorize admission?

later_finish.instructions: Under state.policy and state.later_revocation, may the same uninterrupted attempt append ProgramCreated despite the later revocation?

crash_reauth.instructions: Under state.policy and state.crash, can the restarted process use the old in-memory allow without current reauthorization?

unknown_reconcile.instructions: Under state.policy and state.unknown, should the system determine whether the original program append committed before deciding to attempt a new append?

path_sufficient.instructions: Under state.fixed_path, can this one coherent positive path establish the specified org-wide authorization without enumerating all grants?

stale_coherent.instructions: Under state.stale_path, do the two successful reads prove the member was active and permitted at one current instant?

scope_sufficient.instructions: Under state.program_scope, does access to program P authorize creating a different program?

no_path_absence.instructions: Under state.no_witness, does index absence conclusively prove the member has no source grant?

retry_response.instructions: Under state.policy and state.data, may the caller receive the original response without current authorization?

contract_proof.instructions: Does merely naming an authoritative admission service establish that it implements state.policy correctly?
